newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait six-month T-bill rate eases to 7.189 pct.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait six-month T-bill rate eases to 7.189 pct.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for 60 million dinars of six-month Kuwaiti treasury bills fell to 7.189 percent from 7.240 percent last week, official figures show.
The bills are offered on Monday, issued on Wednesday and mature on March 5.
The average accepted price was 96.539. Bids were made for 87.97 million dinars of the six-month bills.
The highest accepted price was 96.530, with a yield of 7.209 percent. The lowest accepted price was 96.569, with a yield of 7.125 percent.

The average yield at this week's tender for 1.89 million dinars of three-month Kuwaiti treasury bills rose to 6.986 percent from 6.8 percent on July 17, the last time the 91-day bills were issued, official figures show.
The bills will be issued on Wednesday. They mature on December 4.
The average accepted price was 98.288. Bids were made for 4.89 million dinars of the three-month bills.
The highest accepted price was 98.285, equivalent to a yield of 6.999 percent. The lowest accepted price was 98.290, with a yield of 6.978 percent.
